    protected readonly createAddressesItem = (): FormGroup => {
        return new FormGroup({
            id: new FormControl<string | null>(null),
            city: new FormControl<string | null>('Amsterdam'),
            street: new FormControl<string | null>(null),
            houseNumber: new FormControl<string | null>(null),

        });

    private readonly resizeAddressesArray = (length: number): void => {
        const formArray = this.form.get('addresses') as FormArray<FormGroup>;
        while (formArray.length > length) {
            formArray.removeAt(formArray.length - 1, { emitEvent: false });
        }
        while (formArray.length < length) {
            const item = this.createAddressesItem();
            if (this.form.disabled) {
                item.disable({ emitEvent: false });
            }
            formArray.push(item, { emitEvent: false });
        }
    };

    constructor() {
        effect(() => {
            const model = this.model();
            this.resizeAddressesArray(model.addresses?.length ?? 0);
            const propertyExpressions = this.fieldsPropertyExpressions();
            const patchedModel = propertyExpressions
                ? { ...model, ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(propertyExpressions).map(([propertyName, expression]) => [propertyName, expression(model)])) }
                : model;
            this.form.patchValue(patchedModel as unknown as typeof this.form.value, { emitEvent: false });
        });
        effect(() => {
            const model = this.model();
            const requiredExpressions = this.fieldsRequiredExpressions();
            if (!requiredExpressions) {
                return;
            }
            Object.entries(requiredExpressions).forEach(([propertyName, isRequired]) => {
                const control = this.form.get(propertyName);
                if (!control) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isRequired(model)) {
                    control.addValidators(Validators.required);
                } else {
                    control.removeValidators(Validators.required);
                }
                control.updateValueAndValidity({ emitEvent: false });
            });
        });
        effect(() => {
            if (this.isReadonly()) {
                this.form.disable({ emitEvent: false });
            } else {
                this.form.enable({ emitEvent: false });
                this.form.get('date')?.disable({ emitEvent: false });
                (this.form.get('addresses') as FormArray<FormGroup>).controls.forEach(itemGroup => itemGroup.get('verified')?.disable({ emitEvent: false }));
            }
        });
    }

    protected readonly onSubmit = (event: Event): void => {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (this.form.valid) {
            this.save.emit(this.form.getRawValue() as IFormMock);
        }

    protected readonly isHidden = (propertyName: string, staticVisible: boolean): boolean => {

    protected readonly isDisabled = (propertyName: string, staticReadonly: boolean): boolean => {
        return this.isReadonly() || (this.fieldsDisableExpressions()?.[propertyName]
            ? this.fieldsDisableExpressions()![propertyName](this.model())
            : staticReadonly);
    };

    protected readonly isOptionSelected = (propertyName: string, value: unknown): boolean =>
        ((this.form.get(propertyName)?.value as unknown[] | null) ?? []).includes(value);

    protected readonly toggleOption = (propertyName: string, value: unknown, checked: boolean): void => {
        const control = this.form.get(propertyName);
        const currentValues = (control?.value as unknown[] | null) ?? [];
        control?.setValue(checked ? [...currentValues, value] : currentValues.filter(item => item !== value));
        control?.markAsDirty();
    };

    protected readonly toggleSelectAll = (propertyName: string, options: { value: unknown; displayName: unknown }[]): void => {
        const control = this.form.get(propertyName);
        const values = options.map(option => option.value);
        const selectedValues = ((control?.value as unknown[] | null) ?? []).filter(value => values.includes(value));
        control?.setValue(selectedValues.length === values.length ? [] : values);
        control?.markAsDirty();
    };
